title: Crestline Fleet Account Early-Pay Discount Base on Invoices Under Dispute
content:
When part of a Crestline Fleet Account invoice is under open dispute, the early-pay discount is measured on what is not in dispute. The discount base of the early-pay discount depends on the dispute standing on the invoice.

## Rule

| Amount under open dispute for the invoice | Discount base |
|---|---|
| more than half (50 percent) of the invoice amount | the invoice earns no early-pay discount at all |
| some amount, but no more than half of the invoice amount | the invoice amount less the amount under open dispute |
| nothing | the whole invoice amount |

The amount under open dispute for the invoice is the total disputed amount of the disputes registered for that invoice whose status is open.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical invoice of 1000.00)

| Amount under open dispute | Discount base |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | 1000.00 |
| 120.00 | 880.00 |
| 500.00 (exactly half) | 500.00 |
| 500.01 | no early-pay discount |

With a hypothetical early-pay rate of 1 percent, a discount base of 880.00 gives a discount of 8.80.
